name: WF-15 Transaction Service v3 — COD Order Creation Boundary

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM public.commerce_idempotency WHERE customer_id=$1 AND action_id=$2 LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO public.commerce_idempotency
(customer_id,action_id,operation,status,result_json,created_at,updated_at)
VALUES($1,$2,$3,'succeeded',$4::jsonb,now(),now())
ON CONFLICT(customer_id,action_id)
DO UPDATE SET status='succeeded',result_json=excluded.result_json,updated_at=now()
RETURNING *;
